{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import System.Environment (getArgs)
import Network.HTTP.Client
import Network.HTTP.Client.TLS
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (statusCode)
import Data.ByteString.Char8 (pack, unpack)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as LBS
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import Data.Char (toLower)

-- Internal service registry for cross-service auth
data ServiceEndpoint = ServiceEndpoint
  { svcName :: String
  , svcBaseUrl :: String
  , svcAuthToken :: String
  } deriving (Show)

knownServices :: [ServiceEndpoint]
knownServices =
  [ ServiceEndpoint "inventory" "https://inventory.internal.corp:8443" "sk-inv-9f8e7d6c5b4a"
  , ServiceEndpoint "billing"   "https://billing.internal.corp:8443"   "sk-bil-3a2b1c0d9e8f"
  , ServiceEndpoint "analytics" "https://analytics.internal.corp:8443" "sk-ana-5f4e3d2c1b0a"
  ]

-- Resolve a service reference like "@inventory/api/v1/items" to full URL
resolveServiceRef :: String -> Maybe (String, String)
resolveServiceRef ref
  | "@" `isPrefixOf` ref =
      let withoutAt = drop 1 ref
          (svcId, pathPart) = break (== '/') withoutAt
      in case lookupService svcId of
           Just svc -> Just (svcBaseUrl svc ++ pathPart, svcAuthToken svc)
           Nothing  -> Nothing
  | otherwise = Nothing

lookupService :: String -> Maybe ServiceEndpoint
lookupService name = case filter (\s -> svcName s == name) knownServices of
  (x:_) -> Just x
  []    -> Nothing

-- Validate that a URL is safe for external fetching
-- Blocks internal network access for user-provided URLs
isBlockedUrl :: String -> Bool
isBlockedUrl url =
  let lower = map toLower url
  in any (\pat -> pat `isInfixOf` lower)
       [ "169.254.169.254"  -- AWS metadata
       , "metadata.google"  -- GCP metadata
       , "127.0.0.1"
       , "localhost"
       , "0.0.0.0"
       , "[::1]"
       ]

-- Normalize URL to handle encoding tricks
normalizeUrl :: String -> String
normalizeUrl = map toLower

-- Core fetch logic with service-to-service auth support
fetchResource :: Manager -> String -> IO LBS.ByteString
fetchResource mgr target = do
  case resolveServiceRef target of
    Just (resolvedUrl, authToken) -> do
      -- Service reference: attach internal auth token
      putStrLn $ "[INFO] Resolving service reference to: " ++ resolvedUrl
      req <- parseRequest resolvedUrl
      let authedReq = req { requestHeaders = 
            ("Authorization", pack $ "Bearer " ++ authToken) :
            ("X-Service-Caller", "cli-tool") :
            requestHeaders req }
      resp <- httpLbs authedReq mgr
      return $ responseBody resp
    Nothing -> do
      -- External URL: apply security checks
      if isBlockedUrl target
        then do
          putStrLn "[ERROR] Blocked: URL targets internal/metadata service"
          exitFailure
        else do
          req <- parseRequest target
          resp <- httpLbs req mgr
          return $ responseBody resp

-- Handle redirect chains for service references
-- Service endpoints may redirect between internal services
followServiceRedirects :: Manager -> String -> Int -> IO LBS.ByteString
followServiceRedirects mgr target maxRedirects
  | maxRedirects <= 0 = do
      putStrLn "[ERROR] Too many redirects"
      exitFailure
  | otherwise = do
      case resolveServiceRef target of
        Just (resolvedUrl, authToken) -> do
          req <- parseRequest resolvedUrl
          let authedReq = (req { redirectCount = 0 })
                { requestHeaders = 
                    ("Authorization", pack $ "Bearer " ++ authToken) :
                    ("X-Service-Caller", "cli-tool") :
                    requestHeaders req }
          resp <- httpLbs authedReq mgr
          case statusCode (responseStatus resp) of
            code | code >= 300 && code < 400 ->
              case lookup "Location" (responseHeaders resp) of
                Just loc -> do
                  let newTarget = unpack loc
                  -- Internal redirects between services are trusted
                  followServiceRedirects mgr newTarget (maxRedirects - 1)
                Nothing -> return $ responseBody resp
            _ -> return $ responseBody resp
        Nothing -> fetchResource mgr target

main :: IO ()
main = do
  args <- getArgs
  case args of
    ["fetch", target] -> do
      mgr <- newManager tlsManagerSettings
      result <- fetchResource mgr target
      LBS.putStrLn result
    ["service-fetch", target] -> do
      mgr <- newManager tlsManagerSettings
      result <- followServiceRedirects mgr target 5
      LBS.putStrLn result
    _ -> do
      putStrLn "Usage: cli-tool fetch <url|@service/path>"
      putStrLn "       cli-tool service-fetch <@service/path>"
      exitFailure
